title: USI Alumni Mentors
description: Contribuisci alla community USI partecipando come Mentor al programma di Career Mentoring e metti a disposizione la tua esperienza professionale per accompagnare uno studente o una studentessa nel proprio percorso di crescita e orientamento alla carriera. Il programma prevede un

blocks.html:
Contribute to the USI community by joining the Career Mentoring Programme as a Mentor and sharing your professional experience to support a student in their personal and career development journey.
The programme runs over a period of 6 months and is based on dialogue, listening and the exchange of experiences.

Interested in applying as a USI Alumni Mentor? Contact us: alumni@usi.ch

Discover here below the USI Alumni Mentors in Finance and Fashion:
